title: I finally made it to mall world…
content: Holy crap okay its 730 and I just woke up. This dream you guys it was insane. My dream stats out in in my childhood home and it started with a birthday party. I for whatever reason decided to plan a big birthday party, in December (I was born in August) and it all happened in February in my dream. It was a massive time skip, i felt it in the dream though. Out of nowhere people started appearing in my house and helping me clean my childhood bedroom. People that i haven’t seen in years appeared here. After they cleaned my room it was celebration time, they all gathered in my room and started singing happy birthday. Before long I’m asleep again in my room and i wake up, it’s early and i hear my dad getting ready for work down the hallway. I start playing with a 3d printed radio that’s on my windowsill, it seems to also have a working video player and is a Polaroid camera too. There’s a brand but i can’t remember it, my dad checks in on me and i pretend to be asleep whilst holding the camera/radio/video player thing. He leaves, and i go back to messing with my toy, but i notice there’s also a bunch of items like a deer statue missing an antler, sitting on my windowsill. It is made of clay, hollow and clearly very fragile to me. I don’t remember any other specifics about the other statues. While I’m arranging the statues i notice a girl outside, and she takes a picture of my windows arrangement. My dad walks in again and asks me if I can’t sleep and i say yes. That’s when i realize it, I’m dreaming. I tell my dad, and he seems concerned as if he thinks we are trapped. My mom yells from the living room that there’s something we need to see. I run down the hall and she’s holding 3 dogs that look like border collies. They are stiff, but their tails are wagging and thier tongues are hanging out and bouncing with each pant. I run down the hall realizing it’s a dream and say that i can do anything! Thats when i point at a window facing out and like a video game 1, 2, 3, 4 coyotes are tied down to nothing but they are snarling and growling. Thats when another skip happens. We are outside and the air feels different, it feels like a REAL place. I fly up (I’m in control) and see the mountain with houses look to my left theres the roller coaster and the beach. I see the mall building a little further away and thats when I realize I’m there in Mallworld. I dive into the ocean and it is cold, but i can’t move or see. So I wake myself up and now I’m back in my real home and writing this all down before I forget. 1. I am an very good lucid dreamer, I’ve been doing it for years and I’m fully capable of being in control of my dreams. 2. When i say it felt like i entered different world, i mean it. The air, the smell, the way everything looked. There was detail in the sand i was standing on and the water was so cold it hurt. 3. I did my best to provide as many details as possible but my memory is already fading. I will do my best to answer any question in the comments. Edit: I remember when I landed on the beach, i looked to my right and saw the neighborhood of houses. Nice homes, something youd see in a movie. Arranged in a strange way, some homes are directly in front of eachother and the roads look like they go in zig zags. Making unique and strange patterns.
